citation: State of Karnataka v. Suresh Kumar (2018) 9 SCC 234
reasoning_summary: Conviction under IPC 302 upheld. Circumstantial evidence chain complete: bloodstains on accused clothing, fingerprints at scene, eyewitness saw accused fleeing. Motive established through family testimony about property dispute.

facts_established.mens_rea: Property dispute created motive, threats made earlier
